scripts.text:
[La Ed]
There MUST be a treasure hidden in that place!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
那个地方一定藏着宝藏！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
If we find it, people will no longer think we're losers~!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
如果我们找到了，大家就不会再觉得我们是失败者了~！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Finally!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
终于！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Let's go find that treasure!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
让我们去找那个宝藏吧！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Let's do it~ !!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
就这么办~！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
By the way...do you think he
would tell us about such a
great treasure so easily?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
话说回来...你觉得他会这么轻易地告诉我们关于这么棒的宝藏的事吗？

scripts.text: Hm? What treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯？什么宝藏？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Wha--?! when did you start listening to us?!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
什--？！你什么时候开始偷听我们说话的？！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Huh...seems like you wanna know
more about the treasure. Well,
this information doesn't come cheap...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈...看来你们很想知道关于宝藏的更多消息嘛。不过，这些情报可不是免费的...

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Plus, we'll need a little
a little something in case
*cough!* ^555555we don't find
anything at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，万一*咳咳！* ^555555我们什么也没找到，^000000 我们也需要一点小小的补偿。

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
If you pay us 1,000 zeny, we will tell you!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
如果你付给我们1,000 Zeny，我们就告诉你！

scripts.text: Pay 1,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 支付1,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Refuse to pay
scripts.translation: 拒绝支付

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Hahahaha! You the man!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈哈哈哈哈！你真是个大好人！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Okay, not too long ago, a famous
adventurer named Niels came back from his travels.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
好吧，不久前，一位名叫尼尔斯的著名冒险者结束了他的旅行回来了。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
*Whispers*
^555555He brought a big box with him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
*小声*
^555555他带了一个大箱子回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Also, he came back in the middle
of the night without telling
anyone. So, of course he's got
some secret, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，他是在半夜回来的，谁也没告诉。所以，他肯定有什么秘密，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Haith]
What could be inside that box~?
It just has to be treasure!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
那个箱子里会是什么呢~？
那肯定就是宝藏！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
So! We decided to go on a journey to find treasure of our own-!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
所以！我们决定踏上旅程，去寻找属于我们自己的宝藏-！！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
The problem is, we are not sure
whether or not Niels would tell
us the location of where he
found the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
问题是，我们不确定尼尔斯会不会告诉我们他是在哪里发现宝藏的...

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Because Niels always treat us like
we're stupid!! Bah~!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
因为尼尔斯总是把我们当傻瓜！！哼~！！

scripts.text: Where is this Niels person?
scripts.translation: 那个叫尼尔斯的人在哪里？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
He's staying at the northern part
of this village.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
他住在村子的北边。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Since we gave you good information,
we expect that you pay us back!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
既然我们给了你这么好的情报，你就得回报我们！

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德，海斯]
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Oh well~! If you don't have the money, then we can't give you the information~
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
哎呀~！如果你没有钱，那我们也没办法给你情报~

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Bah! Whatever~
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哼！随便啦~

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
Mr. Niels is at the table in the
corner. He has many interesting
stories about the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
尼尔斯先生在角落的桌子旁。他有很多关于这个世界的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
I am not sure where he has been
this time. He just laughs and
says 'I don't think I am fit
for this teaching job.'
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
我不确定他这次去了哪里。他只是笑着说“我觉得我不适合这份教书的工作”。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
In the meantime, people keep
visiting Mr. Niels... and I
can't help but wonder...
Where has he gone?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
在此期间，人们一直来拜访尼尔斯先生...而我忍不住在想...
他到底去了哪里？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Hmm? What's that look for?
Ah~ You must of heard the rumors
of me finding some kind of
treasure. Yeah, that's understandable...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
嗯？那是什么眼神？
啊~ 你一定是听说了我找到某种宝藏的传闻吧。嗯，这很正常...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, those rumors of me stumbling
on some wonderful treasure is
just the result of overactive
imaginations. All I've found
was a little something to add
to my collection.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
嗯，那些关于我偶然发现某种奇妙宝藏的传闻，不过是人们过度想象的结果。我找到的只是一些可以加入我收藏的小东西。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
But...since I've proven to myself
that 'it' actually exists by
seeing it with my own eyes,
to me, what I've obtained is a
valuable treasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
但是...既然我已经亲眼看到并证明“它”确实存在，那么对我来说，我获得的就是一笔宝贵的财富。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
This village of Comodo!
Don't you think the caves are too
small and narrow for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
这个克魔岛的村庄！
你不觉得那些洞穴有点太小太窄了吗？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
So I was thinking about it...
And I came to the conclusion that
there should be something hidden
inside the cave...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
所以我一直在思考...
然后我得出了结论，洞穴里应该藏着什么东西...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
And then!
I finally found it.
The patch to 'the place'
that no one has ever found!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
然后！
我终于找到了。
通往“那个地方”的入口，那是从来没有人发现过的地方！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
.......Hm?

[Niels]
I was expecting a spectacular and
rather dramatic sound effect
for my declaration!
Eh, oh well...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
我原本期待在宣布这个消息时，能有一个非常壮观且戏剧性的音效！
唉，算了...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, in the spirit of discovery,
don't ever think of asking me
about directions to 'the place'
or about what is in 'the place.'
I wouldn't want to spoil the
surprise.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
本着探索的精神，
千万别问我“那个地方”的方向，
也别问那里有什么。
我可不想破坏这份惊喜。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
If you're a real adventurer,
I expect you to scream at the
top of your lungs...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
如果你是个真正的冒险者，
我期待你扯开嗓子大喊...

scripts.text:
[Niels]
'Ahhhh! I need to know what it
is!!' Kick the door open and run
like hell to find this place on
your own!!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
“啊啊啊！我想知道那是什么！！”
然后一脚踹开门，拼命奔跑，
靠你自己找到这个地方！！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Now! Hurry and seek this place
out! Will this place be a totally
new world, or will it be a trap
to hell?! Go forth, meet your
destiny, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
好了！快去寻找这个地方吧！
那里会是一个全新的世界，
还是通往地狱的陷阱？！
去吧，去迎接你的命运，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[???]
Huh?
You're not one of us, are you?
scripts.translation:
[???]
咦？
你不是我们这边的人吧？

scripts.text:
[???]
Heh! Hi!
My name is Haatan.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嘿！你好！
我叫哈坦。

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
...*Sigh*
I am sorry, but I cannot play with
you right now. My parent's house
was struck by lightning yesterday
and it burned down our roof...
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
...*叹气*
对不起，我现在不能和你玩。
昨天我家被雷劈了，
屋顶都烧坏了...

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
 . . . !

[Haatan]
Oh yes! Could you help me?
You look pretty well off...
Can donate some money for
re-constructing my parents' house?
You Rune-Midgartsians are all
richer than Utans! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
对了！你能帮帮我吗？
你看起来很有钱的样子...
能捐点钱帮我爸妈重建房子吗？
你们伦姆加德人比乌坦人有钱多了！求求你了！

scripts.text: (Nod head)
scripts.translation: (点头)

scripts.text: (Shake head)
scripts.translation: (摇头)

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Whoaaaa!!
You the man~!
Thank you so much, yay~!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
哇哦！！
你真是个大好人~！
太感谢你了，耶~！

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Uh...
It looks like...
You don't have much
yourself...
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
呃...
看起来...
你自己也不宽裕...

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
非常感谢你！

scripts.translation:

乌~姆巴乌姆巴~ 乌~姆巴乌姆巴~

...umbah? Umbahumbah!! Umbaum!
scripts.translation:

...乌姆巴？乌姆巴乌姆巴！！乌姆巴乌姆！

scripts.translation:
[科坦]
哇，你真的给我肉？谢谢！我会用这些回报你的。

scripts.text:

Hah! You don't have Meat,
but pretend that you do?!
I hate people who lie
to me!!
scripts.translation:
[科坦]
哈！你没有肉，
却假装你有？！
我讨厌骗我的人！！

[Pasto]
Oh my god~! Finally,
another Rune-Midgartsian!
I've never seen anyone from
home in this place before!
Nice to meet you, my name is Pasto!
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
天哪~！终于，
又一位来自鲁恩·米德加特的人！
我以前从未在这个地方见过家乡的人！
很高兴认识你，我叫帕斯托！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
This place is called Umbala.
The local people in this village
have formed a culture that's
totally different from other
places I've been.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
这个地方叫汶巴拉。
这个村庄的当地人
形成了一种与其他地方
完全不同的文化。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I guess it's because this
place has been isolated from
other regions because of its
geographical features.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我想这是因为这个地方
由于地理特征
与其他地区隔绝的缘故。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
They look different from us, and
use a language that is still very
confusing to me. I was also
confounded by their different use
of facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
他们看起来和我们不同，
使用的语言对我来说
仍然非常令人困惑。我也被他们
不同的面部表情用法搞糊涂了。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Of course, there are some
similarities. However, you might
want to be careful about certain
issues.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
当然，也有一些相似之处。不过，
你可能需要注意某些问题。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Sometimes, what you say or do
or do could be misinterpreted as
having the totally opposite meaning.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
有时候，你说的话或做的事
可能会被误解为
完全相反的意思。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I wish I could speak their
language...*Sigh*
...Or I wish I could meet more
people here that speak my
language...I...I'm...
So very lonely...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
真希望能学会他们的语言... *叹气*
...或者希望能在这里遇到更多
说我们语言的人...我...我...
太孤单了... *抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Umbah umbah woogawoo...
oops, sorry! I'm so used
to speaking in Utan by now.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
乌巴乌巴 呜嘎呜...
哎呀，抱歉！我现在太习惯
说乌坦语了。
很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I never imagined that I would
meet another person from
the homeland in this village.
Hahahahah~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我从没想过会在这个村庄
遇到另一位来自家乡的人。
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I came here to seek strong people
to help me master my fighting
skills. But I was soon frustrated
because it took me a long
time to learn the language...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我来这里是为了寻找强者，
帮我磨练战斗技巧。但我很沮丧，
因为花了好长时间才学会语言...

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Well, now I am kind of used to my
circumstances. Even though it
took me a while to used to
Utan culture. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
嗯，现在我已经有点习惯
这里的情况了。虽然花了一段时间
才适应乌坦文化。哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
But you know what was the weirdest
thing I found out about Utan
culture? At first the Utan men
seemed to have, shall we say, a
strong species preservation instinct.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
但你知道我在乌坦文化中发现
最奇怪的是什么吗？起初，
乌坦的男性似乎有一种，
怎么说呢，强烈的种族繁衍本能。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
There are many Utan playboys in
this village. Some may think
the Utans are primitive in
this respect, but...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这个村庄有很多乌坦花花公子。
有些人可能认为乌坦人在这方面
很原始，但是...

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
As I learned more about them,
I eventually realized that their
courtship rituals are actually
more advanced than anything the
Rune-Midgarts culture has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
随着我对他们了解得更多，
我最终意识到他们的求偶仪式
实际上比卢恩·米德加兹文化
中任何事物都要先进。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
It's really quite fascinating.
I'm actually still learning
quite much from the Utan
playboys and their awesome methods.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这真的非常迷人。
我实际上还在向乌坦花花公子
学习他们厉害的方法。

scripts.text:
[Jertan]
Bungee jumping can be dangerous,
and you can risk your life doing
it. We Utans have consider
bungee jumping an important
part of the ceremony of
becoming an adult.
scripts.translation:
[杰尔坦]
蹦极是有危险的，
做这件事可能会危及生命。
我们乌坦人认为蹦极是
成人礼的重要组成部分。

scripts.text:
[???]
Umbaumbah humba.
Woo umbaumbaumbabah woo humbah
Umbababah umba umba.
scripts.translation:
[???]
乌巴乌巴 哼巴。
呜 乌巴乌巴乌巴巴 呜 哼巴
乌巴巴巴 乌巴 乌巴。

scripts.text:
[Arotan]
Completing the bungee jump
is very difficult to do.
Today, we are here in celebration
of the people that made it and
have shown their courage.
scripts.translation:
[阿罗坦]
完成蹦极是非常困难的。
今天，我们在这里庆祝
那些成功完成并展现出勇气的人。

scripts.text:
[???]
Woo umbaumbaumbabah woo humbah
Umbababah umba umba.
scripts.translation:
[???]
呜 乌巴乌巴乌巴巴 呜 哼巴
乌巴巴巴 乌巴 乌巴。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
It's really scary, falling from
such a high place...
But I guess you have to do it,
otherwise no one will ever
consider you a grownup.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
从那么高的地方掉下来
真的很吓人...
但我想你必须这么做，
否则没人会把你当大人。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
I guess I don't want to
be a grownup right away.
But some kids my age are
in too big of a hurry
to not be kids anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
我想我不太想马上
长大成人。但有些和我同龄的孩子
太急于不再做孩子了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What up, loser!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
嘿，输家！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What's the matter,
ya big Rune-Midgartsian?!?!
I just called you a 'loser!'
I guess you're too stupid
to understand!!
Hahahahahahaahahhahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
怎么了，
你这个大卢恩·米德加兹人？！
我刚才叫你“输家”！
我猜你太笨了
听不懂！！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
Uh...oh!

[Bertan]
It looks like you can understand
me--! Good job, good job!
Alright, by way of apology,
do you want to hear a joke?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
看来你能听懂我说话——！
干得好，干得好！
好了，作为道歉，
你想听个笑话吗？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Alright, alright.
Here we go.
Ummmm...
Alright, I got one.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，好吧。
开始了。
嗯……
好了，我想到了一个。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What did the Rune-Midgartsian
say to the Savage?
...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
卢恩·米德加兹人对野猪说了什么？
……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I don't know...
But they didn't have any
trouble understanding
each other!!! HAHAHAHA~!
Get it? 'Cuz, like,
they're both pigs~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我不知道……
但他们彼此之间完全没有
沟通障碍！！！哈哈哈哈哈~！
懂吗？因为，
他们俩都是猪~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Not funny, huh?
Oh well. I guess my
sense of humor is just
too sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
不好笑，是吗？
算了。我想我的
幽默感就是
太高级了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay...what's the best
way to tame an Orc Lady?
Give up..?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧……驯服兽人女子的
最佳方法是什么？
放弃..？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
With a wedding ring!
HAHAHAHAHAHAHHA!
Oh God~ I'm hilarious!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
用结婚戒指！
哈哈哈哈哈！
天哪~ 我太搞笑了！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
...Wait.
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
……
……等等。
等一下……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
That's not even funny...
Just incredibly...
Scary...
Brrr--!
She's hideous!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
这根本不好笑……
简直太……
可怕了……
嘶——！
她长得真丑！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Actually...forget it.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
其实……算了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I was going to say a
knock knock joke about
Isis, but then decided
that kind of humor is
too low brow.
...Zing!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我本来想说一个
关于蛇女伊丝的
敲门笑话，但后来觉得
那种幽默
太粗俗了。
……叮！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Why are Rune-Midgartsians
SOOoOOoo...
Um, hmmmmm.
Maybe that joke
isn't so good for this
situation, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
为什么卢恩·米德加兹人
这么……
嗯，嗯……
也许这个笑话
不适合这个场合，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay, why is it that
GMs prefer not to be
seen...? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，为什么
GM们不喜欢被看到...？
猜不到？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
BECAUSE THOSE GUYS WEAR
SKIRTS ~! HAHAHA!
OH MAN, I MADE A FUNNY!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
因为那些家伙穿
裙子 ~！哈哈哈！
天哪，我讲了个笑话！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
*Whew* Yowza~
Oh, man.
Utterly classic.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
*呼* 哇哦~
天哪。
太经典了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
A Crusader, an Alchemist and a Novice walk into a bar.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
一个十字军、一个炼金术士
和一个初心者走进了一家酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Inside, they see a sign that
says '^CC0000Monster Help Agency:
LADIES ONLY.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
里面有一块牌子写着：
'^CC0000魔物帮助机构：
仅限女士。^000000'

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^000099Oh!^000000' says the Crusader.
'^000099It's a lucky thing we are
all ladies.^000000' She goes up
and says '^000099Gimmie a ride.^000000'
Kinda rude for a Crusader,
but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^000099哦！^000000'十字军说。
'^000099幸好我们都是女士。^000000'
她走上前说'^000099给我来个坐骑。^000000'
对十字军来说有点粗鲁，
但无所谓。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Grand PecoPeco appears
and is all '^CC0000I'll give you
a ride, baby. Careful, this
road can get buuuuumpy.^000000'
And then they're off.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然，一只
大嘴鸟出现了，
它说'^CC0000我带你飞，宝贝。
小心，这条路可能
会颠簸。^000000'
然后她们就出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Next comes the Alchemist
and she's like '^330099I need
help killing Zombies^000000' and
then this Marine Sphere
comes from out of
nowhere and is all...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
接下来是炼金术士，
她说'^330099我需要
帮助杀腐尸^000000'，
然后一只气泡虫
从不知哪里冒出来，
它说……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I got your fire. Careful
baby, touch me the wrong
way and I might just
exploooode.^000000' So then
they're off on their
merry way too.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^CC0000我懂你的意思。小心点，宝贝，
要是碰错地方，我可能
会炸开的。^000000'
然后她们也
高高兴兴地出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Finally, the Novice
comes up and says
'^006633I need someone to
party with.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
最后，那个初心者
走上前说
'^006633我需要
一个队友。^000000'

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Hode pops up and says...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然，一条蚯蚓
冒了出来，说……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I know some people
but let me check my
Rolodex. HODE on!^000000'
....
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^CC0000我认识一些人，
但让我查查我的
通讯录。HODE！^000000'
……

[贝尔坦]
……
……
不行吗？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Well, come on!
I can't be funny
all the time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好了，别笑了！
我总不能
一直搞笑吧，你知道吗？

[Boorkatan]
Huh? You're from Rune-Midgarts,
aren't you? Have you ever been bungee jumping?
scripts.translation:
[布尔卡坦]
咦？你是来自卢恩·米德加兹的，
对吧？你玩过蹦极吗？

scripts.text: Yeah

would have thought someone from
outside would know how to do it.
Okay, I'll take your word for

scripts.translation:

哇，真让人惊讶！我从来没想过
外面的人会知道怎么做。
好吧，我相信你，
欢迎来到我们的村庄。

scripts.text:
[Boorkatan]
Er, I see...
As part of the ceremony of
adulthood, all Utans have to do
a bungee jump. When I grow up,
I'm gonna do it too, and prove
to everybody that I am a man!
scripts.translation:
[布尔卡坦]
呃，我明白了……
作为成年仪式的一部分，
所有乌坦人都必须
进行一次蹦极。等我长大了，
我也要去做，
向所有人证明我是个男人！

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
I too did the bungee jump when I
was young. I remember it well...
It was my first time, and the
ground rushed up to meet me...
For a moment, I thought I was
going to get myself killed...
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
我年轻时也做过蹦极。
我记得很清楚……
那是我第一次，
地面飞快地向我冲来……
有一瞬间，我以为
自己要没命了……

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
But after I made it, I was so
proud of myself~
Some Utans may not agree, but
I think bungee jumping is an
important part of the ceremony
of adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
但当我成功后，
我感到无比自豪~
有些乌坦人可能不认同，
但我认为蹦极是
成年仪式中重要的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
It's been a long time since I last
saw a Rune-Midgartsian~!
Welcome, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
好久没见到
卢恩·米德加兹的人了~！
欢迎你，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
We Utans use this place for
bungee jumping. Many Utan
youngsters have shown their
bravery, earned their
self-respect, and became
adults in this very place.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
我们乌坦人
在这里进行蹦极。
许多乌坦年轻人
在这里展现了勇气，
赢得了自尊，
并成为了成年人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. A few unlucky people
just fell and died after
messing up their bungee jump. And
a few had heart attacks while
looking at other people jumping down...
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
哦...对。有几个人运气不好，
蹦极时出了差错，
摔下来就死了。
还有几个人看着别人跳下去，
结果心脏病发作了...

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
So...
Be careful when you walk around,
You don't want to fall off.
And if you want to try a bungee
jump, you should get yourself ready.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
所以...
走路时要小心，
别掉下去了。
如果你想尝试蹦极，
最好先做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. Supposedly,
there's an unidentified
creature living in the water...
So if you happen to get dunked,
get out of there~!
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
哦...对。据说水里
住着一只身份不明的生物...
所以如果你不小心掉进水里，
赶紧爬出来~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Umbala has many many trees!
I, Mutakutan, like trees so much.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
汶巴拉有很多很多树！
我，穆塔库坦，非常喜欢树。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There is one special tree I like
the most! That is the oldest and
biggest tree in Umbala!
No wait, I think it is the oldest
and biggest in the world...
I'm sure it is!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
有一棵特别的树我最喜欢！
那是汶巴拉最古老、
最大的一棵树！
不对，我觉得它是
世界上最古老、最大的...
我敢肯定！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's really really big and old!
It's so tall, even I haven't seen
the top of this tree yet. I tried
climbing it before, but I could
never reach the top...even though
I'm great at tree climbing.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它真的非常非常大，非常非常老！
它太高了，连我
都还没见过树顶。我以前
试着爬过，但永远
爬不到顶...尽管
我很擅长爬树。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Oh, also the fruits from the tree
are very tasty! I bet they are the
most delicious fruit in the world~
Sweet and sour...eating it just
makes you feel refreshed and
invigorated~!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
哦，还有，这棵树结的果实
非常美味！我敢打赌它们是
世界上最好吃的水果~
酸甜可口...吃下去
让人神清气爽，
充满活力~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There's an amazing story about
this fruit. An old man in my
village was suffering from a
mortal disease...nothing
seemed to help...
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
关于这种果实
有一个神奇的故事。村里
有一位老人患上了
绝症...什么药
都没用...

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
But after he took medicine made
from the ground leaves of this
tree, he became healthy and sound
again! I think God sent us the
tree to bless us.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
但在他服用了用这棵树
落叶制成的药后，
他又恢复了健康！我觉得
是上帝赐给我们这棵树
来保佑我们的。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's at north of my village, so
why don't you go see the greatness
of this tree for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它在村子的北边，
你不妨亲自去看看
这棵树的宏伟吧？
